BOSTON REDEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY City Hall / 1 City Hall Square / Boston, Massachusetts 02201 / Telephone (617) 722-4300
November 12, 1975
Ms. Martha Goldsmith
Office of Community Development
City Hall, Room 703
Boston, Massachusetts, 02201
RE: Clearance of Unsafe Buildings
Draft Environmental Impact Statement
Dear Ms. Goldsmith:
We have reviewed the Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the Clearance of Unsafe Buildings programs. In general, we feel that the Draft Statement was well written and comprehensive in its assessment of the proposed project and its impacts on the environment. We do have some specific comments and questions, however, as follows:
P.5 (Public Health): Item under "Potentially Adverse" should be under "Measures to Minimize Harm".
P.6 (Aesthetics): "Measures to Minimize Harm" -should be identified.
P.27 §2: Explain "Washington Park along with Roxbury" (BRA rehabilitation project).
P.29 $1: Quincy MBTA does not border neighborhood D, should be the Penn-Central Midlands Branch.
PP. Pages are transposed.
39
PP. Discrepancy re problem of housing abandonment in Wellington Hill (§4, p. 57 vs. §1, P. 59); resolve
& 59
P.68 Why isn't Centre Street shown on map (listed in Table 7)?
P.S2 Why is Saugus shown as "approved site" on map but not listed in Table 13?
